answer: Raven-beacon decay bond: each identity locks 50 credits in a raven-sealed bond. Each epoch a beacon pulse fades the bond 12% along a spiral; renewal needs key-signed work, and a raven auditor replays the pulse log. A faded or rented bond still names its owner's key and burns. First renewal costs 25, the k-th 25+8(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 4,021,000 plus 50,000 locked against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 25 once per epoch, keeps its share.
